status: Scenario handles of the recoverable-root identity profile (recoverable-root-v1 on rc/2). Handle RR-NN is the registered conformance case C-id-(45+NN) (profile note §10); 'conformance' is that case's harness status (covers, partial or pending) and a test in internal/conformance keeps it equal to what the tests declare. The reader is active and there is no writer (KNOWN-LIMITS L-23): every case is built from signed lines through the rc/2 reader and the admission adapter (internal/identity, recoverable_cases_test.go), with the reference model's own copies as the oracle. A case is covered only when its whole required outcome is checked end to end with signed evidence; the one partial case waits on the resource layer (issue #285).
